# CNN-BiGRU-Attention: VeReMi v4 results, 14 November 2026

Exact private run: `qwerasdf3004/veremi-central-cnn-bigru-attention-e50/1`, COMPLETE50/50. Two TeslaT4;118,288 trainable parameters. [Adaptation](rebuild.md).

Total recorded train+evaluation time: 6.05600 hours (excludes setup and some checkpoint/final audit overhead). Batch4096, micro256/GPU, seed42, AdamW, cosine50epochs. Train37,361,273 rows; test9,347,679 rows;77features,16classes.

Headline epoch50. Highest observed test macro-F1: epoch44; retrospective observation, not validation-selected checkpoint. Source snapshot/fingerprint and data hashes match the frozen notebook and prior audited v4 run. All50 CMs and JSON/CSV ten metrics audited locally. Final predictions→CM and final strict weights/BN/optimizer PASS. Earlier prediction/weight audits rely on the completed Kaggle verifier.

AMP skipped 177 of456100 optimizer attempts; worst epoch 6/9122. No epoch exceeded the fixed guard. These are scaler skips, not dropped input rows.

Dataset caveats: temporal last20% split within receiver; train includes prior validation fold. Scenario/world context can provide shortcuts; Sybil prior changes from8.0%train to17.7%test. Benign/timeDelay ambiguity remains. This is a16-class VeReMi adaptation, not a reproduction of binary CAN paper scores. No additional data filtering introduced.

All values below are fractions, rounded to five decimals. In single-label multiclass evaluation, accuracy = precision_micro = recall_micro = recall_weighted = f1_micro.
